note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Cookstown rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Seventeen candidates were nominated (nine Unionists, six Nationalists, two Independents); Beaghmore and Lissan were contested and the other thirteen nominees were returned unopposed (Mid-Ulster Mail, 24 May 1952, p. 5). No nomination was received for Killycolpy; the paper expected the retiring member, Mr. Patrick J. Duffy, senr., to be re-elected; as the retiring member he was deemed re-elected. Labels are the list's group headings. Cameron was the outgoing member.
